changes.change: Playback and reading preparation use revisions and abort signals, recheck after asynchronous transitions, retain current-operation loading state, and retire late returned sessions. Playback captures its API authority before share teardown. Reading attachment cancels older opens and local file hashing terminates on abort. Reading session admission also checks request cancellation.
changes.verification: Compiled-current-module tests cover stop/close before delayed response, reader stop transition cancellation, attachment supersession, captured share cleanup, replacement loading and hash termination. Playback server cancellation beyond a returned ID is coordinated with the root-owned playback server change.

changes.change: Explicit audio retry bypasses same-item resume and requests a fresh prepared session without forcing fromStart; normal same-item playback still resumes. The retry-only flag is removed before the server request.
changes.verification: Client fixture asserts normal resume sends no prepare request, recovery sends exactly one new prepare and replacement stop does not cancel its own request.

changes.change: Bookmark writes retain the latest failed position and return drain success. Close waits for a successful drain before clearing or retiring the session. Failure leaves the reader and file available with its existing notice and a Retry save action. New page turns replace older failed pending positions.
changes.verification: Client regressions reject the final write and assert session/position/unsaved notice remain, no close request is sent, retry saves the newest page, and failed older writes cannot replace newer queued pages.

changes.change: After provider work, bookmark selection and session insertion run under the same user advisory transaction lock used by Reread. The transaction rechecks user/category and locks/rechecks connected source generation and enabled instance before copying a bookmark.
changes.verification: Added guarded database race regression: concurrent preparation and Reread must leave preparation either closed by reset or carrying a null bookmark. DB execution remains with the coordinator.

changes.change: Reading replacement publishes the prepared new source before closing the old source. Server item handover revalidates the replacement inside the room transaction and can restore only an existing recent host membership whose prior source was deliberately closed but remains unexpired and authorized. Removed actors, expired old sources, expired rooms and invalid replacement sources are rejected.
changes.verification: Pure ordering test asserts item publication precedes old-session retirement. Added guarded DB tests for intervening roomState, live host retention, expired/missing membership rejection, delegated controller handover and kicked-controller rejection.

changes.change: Failed party source suppression keys work, medium, edition, duration and reading format. A changed descriptor clears suppression and permits one new preparation; unchanged failed descriptors remain suppressed. Existing Retry UI remains unchanged.
changes.verification: Compiled party-client fixtures cover edition recovery and reading format/duration changes while asserting no repeated preparation for unchanged failures.
